caseNameFull: Butz, Secretary of Agriculture v. Hein and Burns, Commissioner, Department of Social Services of Iowa v. Hein

opinions.text: .Appeals from D. C. S. D. Iowa. [Probable jurisdiction noted, ante, p. 904.] Motion for appointment of counsel granted and Robert Bartels, Esquire, of Iowa City, Iowa, is appointed pursuant to this Court’s Rule 53 (7) to serve as counsel for appellee Hein in these cases.
